posts.body: Hi I have been through various threads here about shopping list for newborns, very helpful indeed. But I still have a very dumb question - where can I buy good quality baby stuff near Central? I am relavatively new to HK and do not speak Cantonese, have always been scared to shop here (the crowd, the language, the attitude of shop assistants) and do most of my shopping online. I will start buying things (not clothes, already get plenty as gifts from friends and family) soon. Thanks a lot.
